summary_1line: Sanjaya describes mythical northern and eastern regions around Meru, their peoples, miraculous trees, long lifespans, and cosmic geography.

image_candidates.scene_text: A colossal Jamvu tree rising into the sky drops enormous fruits that burst on the ground, releasing a shining silver river flowing around Mount Meru.
In the radiant land of the Northern Kurus, beautiful twin couples walk among golden sands and trees that yield milk, clothes, and ornaments.
Ascetics glowing like gold surround the blazing sun near Mount Malyavat, entering its orbit after long austerities.
